name: Permit status
description: Where an application has reached. Refusals, withdrawals, and revocations are included on purpose. That way the data can show how many applications actually succeed, not just the ones that were granted.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Applied
hasDefinedTerm.description: Received. Not yet reviewed in detail.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Approved
hasDefinedTerm.description: Decided in favor, but not yet issued — for example, waiting on fees.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Withdrawn
hasDefinedTerm.description: Pulled by the applicant before a decision was made.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Expired
hasDefinedTerm.description: Lapsed without being used, or past its valid dates.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Revoked
hasDefinedTerm.description: Pulled by the authority after being issued.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Completed
hasDefinedTerm.description: The work is finished and signed off.
